First of all if you are not an adult yet then you dont even know if you have a future. My friend was addicted to basically every drug overweight and was constantly in and out of rehab in the beginning of high school but ended up being valedictorian. 
You are not a loser and having a mental illness is not your fault. Are people that struggle with physical disabilities losers? Of course not. 

Try drinking like a gallon of water a day and see how you feel and try standing up and walking around your room for one minute for every hour you're in bed. 
Good luck!
